title: Yearbook and Mixtape
author: Yara Thornbury
blurb: Ines Hartwell, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
